chunks: From him, from Faḍālah, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sinān, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
“The garment is not to be wrapped around him; rather, it is to be laid over him. And when he is entered into the grave, it is placed beneath his cheek and beneath his side.”

key_terms.اَلْبُرْدُ: the garment or cloak used in the shrouding context
key_terms.اَلْقَبْرَ: the grave into which the deceased is placed
key_terms.يُطْرَحُ: is laid or cast over the body

ai.seo_question: How should the burd be placed on the deceased and in the grave according to hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding how the burd should be used for the deceased. It specifies that it should be laid over the body rather than wrapped around it, and then placed under the cheek and side when the deceased is put into the grave.
